proposals.expected_signal: If popularity bias and over-smoothing are limiting full-sort NDCG@10 on ML-1M, a degree-aware residual propagation variant should improve head-tail balance and ranking stability over plain uniform-hop
proposals.failure_mode: Residual mixing may dilute collaborative signal and collapse back to near-MF behavior, yielding flat or negative NDCG@10 changes despite cleaner propagation.
proposals.hypothesis: A plausible next-lineage change is to keep LightGCN-style linear neighborhood propagation but alter the propagation mechanism with degree-aware residual blending across layers, so shallow personalized signal is preserved while high-degree nodes contribute less noisily.
